findings.claim: Gilead 於 2026-02-22 與 Arcellx 簽訂併購協議（現金 $115/股加 CVR），2026-04-28 完成收購。
findings.excerpt: In accordance with the terms of the Merger Agreement, on April 28, 2026, Gilead completed the acquisition of the Company.

findings.claim: HIV 反壟斷集體訴訟（2019/2020 起）與 Viread/Truvada 等產品責任訴訟（約 23,000 名現行原告）仍在進行；聯邦首場 bellwether 審判排定 2027 年 3 月，Missouri 集體認證 2026-01 被駁回。
findings.excerpt: The federal court set a trial date of March 2027 for the first bellwether trial of the remaining cases. In the putative class action pending in Missouri, the district court issued an order in January 2026 denying, among other things, plaintiffs’ motion for class certification.

findings.claim: 2026 年多項 FDA 核准：Hepcludex（HDV，2026-05-22 加速核准）、Trutakna（atacicept，IgAN，2026-07-07）等；BIC/LEN 單錠 HIV 複方獲優先審查，決策結果搜尋未證實。
findings.source: Yahoo Finance：Gilead Wins FDA Approval for First HDV Treatment Hepcludex／搜尋摘要

findings.claim: 2025-06 FDA 對 GS-1720/GS-4182 HIV 試驗下臨床暫停；其後多家律所發布投資人調查通告（非已提起之訴訟）。
